purpose: Teach: フロイト/語りかけ/サーカス/サイレン/培っ/エディタ/必殺/イースター

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、フロイトの本、絶対、読んだわよな、ばあさん、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When we were young, you remember don't you — I read those Freud books so seriously. Gran, do you remember?
lines.style: Soft, reaching back into memory. Gentle insistence on the question, as if checking she's still there with him in that time. Warmth in the repetition.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。若い頃、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、優しく、絶対、語りかけてくれた、絶対、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Yes. And I remember how you would speak to me so gently back then, so carefully. You were always so kind, weren't you?
lines.style: Eyes brightening at the shared recollection. A small, satisfied nod in her voice. Speaking as if confirming something she's held onto.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、家族で、絶対、サーカス、絶対、見に行ったわよな、ばあさん、覚えてる?本気で、絶対、思い出
lines.en: And that time we took the whole family to the circus — you haven't forgotten that, have you? I think of it so often.
lines.style: Tender longing. The image unfolds as he speaks. A gentle pause before the question, as if he can see it happening again.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 昔、本気で、絶対、消防車のサイレン、絶対、少なかった時代、絶対、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: I do remember. The sirens were so much rarer then, everything was quieter. Those days feel like they were in a different world.
lines.style: Quiet reflection, gazing backward. Her voice settles into the memory like sitting down. Each word deliberate and slow.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 長年、本気で、絶対、培ってきた、絶対、私たちの関係、絶対、宝物だな、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、感謝
lines.en: All these years we've built together, Gran — it's all been precious to me. I'm truly grateful for what we have.
lines.style: Voice deepens with sincerity. A small catch before gratitude, as if the weight of years has just touched him. Not rushed.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、エディタを、絶対、使う仕事、絶対、なかった時代、絶対、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Back when we were young, before computers took over everything — I remember those days so clearly. When work was still work done by hand.
lines.style: Distant and wondering, as if looking at an old photograph. Her voice softens at the edges, comfortable in that older time.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、必殺仕事人の、絶対、ドラマ、絶対、よく、本気で、見たわよな、ばあさん、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Those were the days we'd watch that ninja drama together, remember? We watched it so many times. It made us laugh.
lines.style: A smile emerging in his voice. Playful memory — the kind of show they'd circle back to. Warm recognition of a shared habit.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、イースター、絶対、外国人の友達と、絶対、楽しんだ、絶対、覚えてる、あなた?本気で、絶対、思い出
lines.en: And Easter with your foreign friends — how happy that was. You were so alive then, so full of light. I hold onto that memory.
lines.style: Tender and immediate, as if the joy is still close. Her voice wraps around the image protectively. A small, satisfied pause at the end.
